steps.title: Sample Storage and Pre-incubation
steps.instruction: Prepare the PAXgene tubes based on the timing of the extraction.

substeps.instruction: If RNA extraction is NOT to be done the next day, place the 2 PAXgene tubes in the 4 °C fridge from blood draw.
Incubate PAXgene Blood RNA Tubes for 24:00:00 at Room temperature (25°C) after blood collection or removal from 4°C before processing.

steps.title: Equipment Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare heating blocks set to 55°C and 65°C.

steps.title: Initial Pellet Wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes and wash the pellet with RNase-free water.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes at 4000 rpm, 25 °C, for 12 minutes.
Remove supernatant and add 4 mL RNase-free water to each tube.
Close tube using a fresh secondary Hemogard closure.
Vortex for 00:00:10 until pellet is dissolved.
Centrifuge at 4000 rpm, 25 °C, for 10 minutes and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Sample Lysis
steps.instruction: Dissolve the pellet and perform protein digestion.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 µL Buffer BR 1, cap, and vortex until the pellet is visibly dissolved.
Pipette sample into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 300 µL Buffer BR2 and 40 µL proteinase K (do not mix these reagents together before adding to samples).
Mix by vortexing briefly.
Incubate for a total of 10 minutes on a heating block at 55 °C: incubate for 00:05:00, briefly vortex, then incubate for another 00:05:00.

steps.title: Lysate Filtration
steps.instruction: Filter the lysate through a PAXgene Shredder spin column.

substeps.instruction: Pipette lysate directly onto the membrane of a lilac-colored PAXgene Shredder spin column placed in a 2 ml processing tube.
Centrifuge at 13000 rpm, 25 °C, for 3 minutes.
Carefully pipette the supernatant of the flow-through into a 1.5 microcentrifuge tube without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: RNA Binding
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample and bind RNA to the spin column.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 µL 100% ethanol to the flow-through, mix by vortexing, and centrifuge at 500-1000 x g for 1-2 seconds to remove drops from the tube lid (do not centrifuge longer to avoid pelleting nucleic acids).
Pipette 700 µL of the sample into a pink PAXgene RNA spin column placed in a 2 ml processing tube and centrifuge at 10000 rpm, 25 °C, for 1 minute.
Place the spin column in a new 2 ml processing tube.
Pipette the remaining sample into the spin column and centrifuge at 10000 rpm, 25 °C, for 1 minute.

steps.title: First Column Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the bound RNA with Buffer BR3.

substeps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 ml processing tube.
Add 350 µL Buffer BR3 into the spin column and centrifuge at 10000 rpm, 25 °C, for 1 minute.
Place spin column in a new 2 ml processing tube and discard the old tube.

steps.title: DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove contaminating DNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Prepare DNase I incubation mix: add 10 µL DNase I stock solution to 70 µL Buffer RDD in a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube, mix by gently flicking (do not vortex), and centrifuge briefly.
Add 80 µL of the DNase I incubation mix directly onto the spin column membrane.
Incubate on the benchtop (20°C - 30°C, Room temperature) for 00:05:00.

steps.title: Post-DNase Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the column after DNase treatment.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 350 µL Buffer BR3 into the spin column and centrifuge at 10000 rpm, 25 °C, for 1 minute.
Place spin column in a new 2 ml processing tube and discard the old tube.

steps.title: Final Column Washes
steps.instruction: Perform final washes with Buffer BR4.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer BR4 (diluted 1:4 in 100% ethanol) into the spin column and centrifuge at 10000 rpm, 25 °C, for 1 minute.
Place spin column in a new 2 ml processing tube and discard the old tube.
Add another 500 µL Buffer BR4 to the spin column and centrifuge at 10000 rpm, 25 °C, for 1 minute.
Place spin column into a new 2 ml processing tube and discard the old tube.
Centrifuge at 13000 rpm, 25 °C, for 3 minutes.

steps.title: RNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA from the column membrane.

substeps.instruction: Place spin column into a new 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube and discard the old tube.
Add 41 µL Buffer BR5 directly onto the spin column membrane and let sit for 00:01:00.
Centrifuge at 10000 rpm, 25 °C to elute the RNA.
Repeat the elution by adding another 41 µL Buffer BR5 to the same tube, let sit for 00:01:00, and centrifuge at 10000 rpm, 25 °C.

steps.title: RNA Heat Treatment and Aliquoting
steps.instruction: Process the eluted RNA for quality control and storage.

substeps.instruction: Combine the two elutes into one tube, then split the volume in half between two tubes labeled RNA-01 and RNA-02.
Place aliquots in the 65 °C heat block for 00:05:00 without shaking, then chill immediately on ice.
Aliquot 3 µL RNA into a 1.5 mL tube for Nanodrop concentration assay.
Aliquot 2 µL RNA into a PCR tube for Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer assay (store at -20 °C if not assayed immediately).

steps.title: Inventory and Storage
steps.instruction: Log and store the RNA samples.

substeps.instruction: Scan and position RNA in the Freezerworks Inventory Program.
Store in the corresponding -80°C freezer, splitting RNA-01 and RNA-02 into separate freezers to prevent loss in case of freezer failure.
